notes: IDENTITY/SCOPE: 'La Redoute Interieurs' (La Redoute Interieurs / LRI) is La Redoute's in-house exclusive home-goods brand, sold through the general laredoute.fr marketplace (confirmed via /brnd/la-redoute-interieurs.aspx and the ?brndid=la-redoute-interieurs filter on category URLs, page titles/breadcrumbs suffixed 'LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS'). The roster's assigned URL (/pplp/100/75363/158092/cat-158093.aspx) itself resolves to a Furniture/small-tables category (node 158092 = 'Furniture' per laredoute.com/laredoute.de mirrors of the same node id) -- it is only an access/identification anchor, not itself a decor page; the actual extraction covers all Home-Decor-relevant branches of the LRI brand catalog (Decoration, Luminaire (Lighting), Art de la table (Tableware)) via the site's own brndid brand filter. INDEPENDENCE FROM S.N.90 (La Redoute UK): confirmed genuinely separate -- different country domain (.fr vs .co.uk), different language/currency (French UI, EUR vs GBP), and critically a different SCOPE of company: S.N.90 extracted the entire unfiltered laredoute.co.uk marketplace across all brands, whereas S.N.106 is specifically the La Redoute Interieurs house-brand subset of laredoute.fr (much smaller counts per category, e.g. Luminaire 283 LRI-only vs a full-catalog number), consistent with the roster listing them as two distinct companies. Node IDs are shared across La Redoute's country sites (same underlying PPLP platform/taxonomy, e.g. Luminaire=75474, Decoration=75443 identical on .fr and .co.uk) but each country storefront carries its own independent stock/pricing -- same conclusion pattern as the project's OKA US/UK and Zara Home precedents. ACCESS: laredoute.fr returns the identical Cloudflare 'Country challenge' 403 interstitial as laredoute.co.uk to direct fetch, a curl_cffi profile, r.jina.ai, and translate.goog (all tested, all blocked/challenged). WebFetch (renders past the interstitial) was the only working route and was used for every page. VERIFICATION: for every included row, the LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS brand filter was confirmed genuinely active by checking the rendered page's <title> tag and breadcrumb both end in 'LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS' (not just the presence of ?brndid= in the URL) -- this check caught two nodes (Miroir de salle de bain / bathroom mirrors, and Horloge / clocks) where the brndid parameter silently failed to filter and the page fell back to the full unfiltered multi-brand count; confirmed with a control test using a nonsense brndid value on the bathroom-mirror URL, which returned the identical 298 -- proving the parameter is ignored on that node rather than reporting a real LRI-specific 0. Both nodes were excluded with a manual-review flag rather than reporting the unfiltered totals. Counts were read from the rendered 'X articles' listing-header text on each brand-filtered page. EXCLUDED and why: Rangement deco 249 (storage: baskets, coat racks, laundry baskets, trunks -- functional storage, matches UK Storage Decor exclusion); Decoration de Noel (Christmas/holiday, name alone confirms exclusion); Guirlande lumineuse 4 (confirmed Christmas-only titles: mini sapin de Noel, couronne de Noel LED -- Home Fragrance/Holiday rule); Accessoire electrique (lighting bulbs/wiring accessories, matches UK Lighting Accessories exclusion); Bas de porte (door stops, functional, matches UK precedent); Objets de decoration enfant 9 (majority storage baskets/trunks, only 2-3 of 9 titles were genuine wall decor -- too small/mixed to carve out, matches UK Kids' Accessories precedent); Accessoire de table 26 (mixed functional dining tools: trivets, napkin rings, butter dish, placemats, sugar bowl -- matches UK's excluded Table Accessories); Couverts and Ustensile de cuisine (cutlery/kitchen tools, standing exclusions); Decoration de jardin 58 (mixed roll-up, majority outdoor cushions/rugs/sun-mattresses which are textile/furniture, only a minority genuine decor items like cache-pot/lanterne -- dropped as a mixed roll-up per 'drop them, dont pad' rule, no clean sub-split available); Miroir de salle de bain and Horloge -- brand filter verification failed on both nodes (see ACCESS/VERIFICATION above), flagged MANUAL REVIEW rather than guessed. RULE 0 GAIN: included Miroir enfant (3, kids-room mirrors) and Decoration murale enfant (11, kids-room wall decor) which a room-word exclusion would have dropped; kept Decoration murale's decorative wall hooks/shelf items per the brief's own decorative-metal include list (decorative hooks, decorative wall racks/shelves) rather than excluding for the room word 'enfant'. Bougie, bougeoir, senteur (64) node name literally includes 'senteur' (scent) but actual product titles inspected (printed pattern candles, LED candles, wax shape candles, ceramic/glass/marble candle holders, photophores) showed no scent/fragrance terminology (parfum, senteur, essence) on any visible title -- kept as Candles and Candle Holders, not treated as Home Fragrance.
